name: Ulysses
description: Ulysses is a writing app for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that organizes Markdown-based sheets, notes, projects, groups, keywords, goals, attachments, exports, and publishing workflows.
agentUseSummary: Ulysses cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because its documented Shortcuts, callback links, share extension, and device controls operate through an installed Apple-platform app, while private writing remains local or in the user's iCloud or Dropbox and Relay Marketplace does not currently ship that separate device-local authority.

blocked.label: Connect Ulysses
blocked.description: Relay does not present an Apple subscription, iCloud, or Dropbox account as a Ulysses API connection and does not silently substitute an installed device app for Railway authority.

blocked.label: Use local Ulysses automation
blocked.description: Apple Shortcuts, callback links, share extensions, Siri, and device controls require Ulysses on the user's Mac, iPhone, or iPad and a local workflow that Relay cannot currently mount.

blocked.label: Access private writing
blocked.description: Relay does not inspect Ulysses libraries or backups, request Apple or Dropbox credentials, automate the app UI, reuse device state, scrape callback identifiers, or call private synchronization services.

blocked.label: Change or publish writing
blocked.description: Creating, appending, attaching, editing, moving, deleting, exporting, or publishing sheets, groups, projects, notes, images, and blog posts remains unavailable until Relay ships explicit local execution and approval boundaries.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled until Relay ships a separately disclosed, user-authorized device-local Ulysses connector using pinned supported automation operations.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay does not silently bridge OpenClaw to Ulysses Shortcuts, device controls, or private local and iCloud writing libraries.
Relay does not silently bridge Hermes to Ulysses Shortcuts, device controls, or private local and iCloud writing libraries.

providerSetup.blocker: Ulysses documents device-local Shortcuts actions, callback links, share extensions, Siri, and controls but no public third-party account API. Ulysses states that writing is stored locally or in the user's iCloud or Dropbox and is not available to Ulysses itself; Relay's current Marketplace runtime excludes local-app command execution and cannot truthfully expose that content from Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request Apple, iCloud, Dropbox, subscription, or publishing credentials; inspect local libraries; automate Ulysses; or show Connect. Reconsider after Relay ships a separately disclosed Mac/iPhone local-connection architecture with app presence, library selection, user authorization, pinned operations, per-action approval, content redaction, audit, and no cloud fallback.

evidence.supports: Ulysses documents Apple Shortcuts on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, including device-local actions that create sheets and append text or attachments to selected sheets.
Ulysses documents app-generated callback links for selected local sheets and groups rather than a public cloud resource API.
Ulysses documents a user-enabled Apple share extension that sends local URLs, text, photos, and other content into an installed app.
Ulysses states that personal writing is not stored on or accessible to its servers and instead remains as local human-readable files or in the user's iCloud Drive or Dropbox.
